topic: Memory Web foundation and sprinkler icon cleanup
currentUserGoal: Remove the Tiny Sprinkler's strange grass halo and recast the Memory Grove as the clean, non-crossing beginning of a very large future skill web.
workCompleted: Cropped the inherited Tiny Sprinkler equipment sprite in Phaser so the row shows the brass sprinkler without its baked-in grass patch.
Scaled the cropped sprinkler cutout to match the visual weight of the other equipment icons on desktop and phone.
Expanded the Memory Tree world from 720x450 to 1040x680 and reduced overview node size from 76 to 64.
Moved Soft Touch to the center and arranged Touch, Vitality, Scourge, Automation, and Resolve as distinct outward directions.
Replaced orthogonal elbow connectors with direct, node-trimmed web links.
Centralized node and connector geometry in MemoryTreeCatalog so rendering and tests use the same paths.
Added regression tests that reject unrelated connector crossings, touching or overlapping links, and links passing through unrelated nodes.
Added a layout contract that preserves a central origin and a world large enough for continued outward expansion.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 78 Vitest tests across nine files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
The final strengthened MemoryTreeCatalog test passed after adding overlap and touching detection.
Desktop browser smoke confirmed a clean central constellation with uncrossed links and a properly sized sprinkler cutout.
Phone browser smoke confirmed the full web overview, zoom controls, and separate selected-skill detail card remain usable.
Browser console inspection found no errors or warnings.

release.status: Local checkpoint only; not pushed, merged, or deployed.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/field-equipment-recast branch.
The preceding field-equipment recast is commit f710611.
knownIssues: The current web contains only eleven memories; the expanded canvas is foundation for future branches, not the finished large tree.
At phone overview scale, node labels are intentionally small; players use zoom and the separate detail card for inspection.
Branch identity is currently communicated by color and direction. Dedicated branch hubs, rings, and many additional memories remain future work.
The sprinkler source PNG still contains grass; the active equipment presentation removes it non-destructively with a texture crop.
nextRecommendedSteps: Design the next memory tier as several small branch clusters around the five established directions.
Give each branch a major circular keystone node and several smaller satellite upgrades to build the desired web silhouette.
Add an optional branch legend or subtle branch-colored background arcs once the node count justifies it.
Playtest the current equipment economy before merging this feature branch.
doNotRevert: Keep Soft Touch as the central origin of the Memory Web.
Keep connector geometry shared between the catalog, renderer, and tests.
Keep the no-crossing and no-node-intersection test guarantees as the web grows.
Keep overview icons compact and use zoom plus the detail card for readable skill information.
Keep the Tiny Sprinkler equipment row free of the baked-in grass halo.
